name: terminal-value-blog
description: Source for terminalvalue.net, an AI engineering blog.

scripts.build:projects: npm --prefix projects/terminal-value-pipeline ci && npm --prefix projects/terminal-value-pipeline run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build:projects && node blog/build.mjs && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=terminal-value --branch=production
scripts.deploy:dev: node blog/build.mjs --drafts && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=terminal-value --branch=dev

author: Filip Stankovic
